title: Field Service Policy for Mobility Equipment — Who Bears a Repair
content:
# Who Bears a Repair — Mobility Equipment

**1. Rented chairs.** While a Mobility Equipment chair is rental active or suspended every repair is Summit Ridge's rental obligation at no charge, completed or swapped within the class's rental repair or swap time, in business days.

**2. Owned chairs — warranty first.** On an owned chair the component's manufacturer warranty applies first, each counted from the delivery date: the frame warranty for the frame, the electronics warranty for joystick and controller, the motor warranty for motor and gearbox, the battery warranty for batteries (counted from the last battery replacement when there is one) and the tire and caster warranty for tires and casters; upholstery and brakes carry no warranty.

**3. Owned chairs — out of warranty.** Out of warranty, a repair of a chair bought or capped under coverage is billed to the coverage as labor at the class's repair labor rate per unit plus parts, the patient owing the cost share; batteries are billed no more often than every battery replacement interval of the class, in months, measured from the latest battery repair on the chair (the delivery date when there has been none). A self-pay chair's out-of-warranty repair is patient paid.

**4. Repair or replace.** When labor plus parts would exceed the class's repair-versus-replace threshold percent of its fee-schedule purchase amount, the chair is replaced instead.

**5. Response.** A technician assesses a reported fault within the class's fault assessment time, in business days, and a loaner is issued where the class provides a loaner during owned-chair repair.

**6. The chair must be with the patient.** A repair is recorded only on a chair the patient still has: the wheelchair record is rental active, suspended or patient owned. The status is read from the system's wheelchair record before the repair is recorded.

## Repair cost

The repair cost is the labor units multiplied by the labor rate per unit, plus the parts amount. **Hypothetical:** 4 units at 23.86 is 95.44; with 120.00 of parts the repair cost is 215.44.

## Who bears it (summary of the clauses)

| Chair | Component in warranty | Who bears the repair |
|---|---|---|
| rental active or suspended | either | Summit Ridge, at no charge |
| owned | yes | the manufacturer's warranty |
| owned, bought or capped under coverage | no | the coverage, labor plus parts; the patient owes the cost share |
| owned, self-pay | no | the patient |

Upholstery and brakes are never in warranty.
